text: Walking slowly, slow, slow, slow,
Past the flowers, here we go!
Now we're running, fast, fast, fast!
Round the garden, zooming past!
Slow and fast, and up and down,
High and low, now spin around!
Yes and no, hello, goodbye,
Come on, copy, give it a try!
Mira jumps up, up, up, up!
Mango wags, a happy pup!
Now bow down, down to the ground,
Up float balloons, pink and round!
Slow and fast, and up and down,
High and low, now spin around!
Yes and no, hello, goodbye,
Come on, copy, give it a try!
Red kite flying high, so high,
Dancing in the big blue sky!
Swooping low, low, low it goes,
Mango sniffs low with his nose!
Slow and fast, and up and down,
High and low, now spin around!
Yes and no, hello, goodbye,
Come on, copy, give it a try!
Yes, yes, yes, we nod our heads,
No, no, no, we shake instead!
Wave hello, the day was fun,
Wave goodbye to the setting sun!
Slow and fast, and up and down,
High and low, now spin around!
Yes and no, hello, goodbye,
Come on, copy, give it a try!
Slow and fast, and up and down,
High and low, now spin around!
Yes and no, hello, goodbye,
Come on, copy, give it a try!
